headline: Wildlife Comedy Awards Draw Record 10,000 Entries Worldwide
meta_description: The Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards released 40 finalists from over 10,000 entries across 112 countries, celebrating humor that builds empathy for animals.
summary_short: The Nikon-sponsored Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards just unveiled its 2026 finalists—chosen from a record-breaking 10,000 entries submitted by photographers in 112 co…
body:
The Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards has announced its 40 finalists for 2026, marking a milestone year for the Nikon-sponsored competition. This year brought an unprecedented wave of submissions: more than 10,000 entries from 112 countries—the highest number in the awards' history. The finalists showcase spontaneous moments of animal behavior that blend humor with raw wildlife authenticity, from an "Elvis" impersonator to an "Angry Bird" and a genuinely spicy orangutan that's best viewed without a drink in hand.

The competition remains free and open to everyone—from complete novices to seasoned professionals—making it an accessible platform for photographers worldwide. Winners compete for substantial prizes, including a once-in-a-lifetime safari in Kenya's Masai Mara with Alex Walker Serian, plus camera equipment from Nikon.

Beyond the laughs lies a deeper purpose. Competition co-founder Tom Sullam explains the driving force: "We use humor to get people to feel empathy towards wildlife—and it's that empathy that creates behavioral change for the better." This philosophy transforms comedic animal moments into a tool for conservation awareness. The public now has a chance to participate through the People's Choice Award voting, with one lucky voter randomly selected to win $500. For photographers eager to submit their best shots, the free competition welcomes entries at www.comedywildlifephoto.com.
quick_facts: Nikon-sponsored awards with Masai Mara safari prize
40 finalists selected; open to all skill levels
People's Choice voting offers $500 random prize
